title: Festivals
wikitext:
Stardew Valley Expanded adds a new festival to the game with two variants: One for when players complete the [[Stardew:Community Center|Community Center]]; and one for when players choose the [[Stardew:Joja Community Development Form|Joja Route]].

The new festival occurs every month on the 22nd day, and all base game villagers, as well as many of the SVE NPCs, will participate.

==Community Day==
On the 21st of any season after the player has completed the Community Center, [[Stardew:Lewis|Lewis]] will appear at your farm to inform you about the new holiday on the 22nd.

Almost all the NPCs come to the Community Center (at different times) to celebrate the holiday, making it a good opportunity for gifting, with the exception of [[Apples]], [[Claire]] (before her six-heart event), [[Stardew:Dwarf|Dwarf]], [[Gunther]], [[Stardew:Krobus|Krobus]], [[Magnus]], [[Martin]], [[Morgan]], and [[Morris]].

Like the [[Stardew:Night Market|Night Market]] and Joja Day, you are free to leave at any time

== Joja Day==
On the 21st of any season after the player has completed the Joja Community Development Projects, [[Morris]] will appear at your farm to inform you about the new holiday on the 22nd.

Being the counterpart to Community Day, almost all NPCs come to JojaMart except for the [[Magnus]], [[Stardew:Pierre|Pierre]], [[Stardew:Caroline|Caroline]], [[Sophia]] and [[Susan]] (Pierre and Caroline having special dialogue about the new festival)

At the festival, exclusive decorations are for sale and seeds for all seasons are available with a 20% cheaper until 8 PM.

Like the [[Stardew:Night Market|Night Market]] and Community Day, you are free to leave at any time.
